resolved_conflicts.explanation: Spelled Buffards by the Forest Fire Lookout Association and TopoQuest, and Buffords on the Forest Lookouts page. The three sources describe the same Buckingham County mountain; the Association spelling is used in this record.

notes_for_editor: Standing rests only on the Forest Fire Lookout Association Virginia list. The Forest Lookouts page is a name-and-county stub with no tower details. TopoQuest gives the summit (711 ft, Buckingham County, Dillwyn map sheet), not the tower. A search snippet mentioned a row reading Private (formerly VDOF), Standing (2008) for this mountain; its source page could not be opened (firelookout.org/lookouts/lo-virginia.html returns 404), and the wording is not in any Buffards page read, so it is not used. Two WebSearch queries were run; neither returned a history. No NHLR or FFLOS page for this tower is in the cache. Owner and access are unknown. Next checks if wanted: the Association's Buffards detail page, an NHLR listing, Virginia Department of Forestry records, and Buckingham County historical sources.
